message.quantumindustries.vault_landed: §b⚡ A Quantum Vault has crash-landed in a smoking crater near you!
message.quantumindustries.vault_opened: §a✔ Quantum Vault unsealed — Quantum Guidebook received!
This Codex was recovered from the Quantum Vault that fell near your arrival point. Its advanced engineering modules are encrypted (????) and will only be decoded as you demonstrate an understanding of each scientific principle.
This manual does NOT provide crafting recipes. It teaches you how to operate each machine, generator, metallurgical furnace and circuit you discover.

Your first task is to craft the Research Notebook (Tier 1 Research Table) and the Empirical Assay Bench (Material Analyzer). Use them to inspect basic materials (wood, stone and copper), unlock your first studies and reveal this book's ???? chapters.
1. Build the Research Notebook/Table and Material Analyzer. 2. Test samples and complete studies at the table to decode this Codex's ???? chapters automatically.
guidebook.quantumindustries.material_obs: Empirical Assay Bench (Inspection, Impact, Heat and Acid)
The Empirical Assay Bench lets you investigate the physical and chemical properties of 13 basic materials before unlocking new technologies at the Research Table.
There are four test methods: Optical Inspection (Bench Magnifier), Mechanical Impact (Hammer / Brass Weights), Heating (Bellows / Flame Test Kit) and Acid Reaction (Test Flask).
Each empirical discovery can be recorded in the Empirical Field Notebook and provides evidence required by Era I and Era II studies.
Place a mineral sample on the bench and apply the appropriate scientific instrument (Magnifier, Hammer, Bellows/Flame or Flask) to record evidence.
guidebook.quantumindustries.manual_formi: Cold Plastic Deformation and Manual Sheet Rolling
The Forming Bench is the workshop's first metalworking machine. It absorbs controlled blows from the Forming Hammer to turn ingots into rolled sheets.
Malleable metals such as Copper, Iron, Gold, Tin and Zinc can be formed directly on the bench's impact bar.
Hold the Hammer in your main hand and a metal ingot in your offhand (or place it on the bench). Strike the Forming Bench three times to produce one Metal Sheet.
guidebook.quantumindustries.alloy_metall: Primitive Pyrometallurgy — Bronze (Cu-Sn) and Brass (Cu-Zn) Smelting
The Bellows Alloy Kiln reaches higher temperatures than a regular furnace by forcing air into the fire, combining two metals into a structural alloy.
In Era I, it combines Copper + Tin (producing low-friction Bronze for gears) and Copper + Zinc (producing Brass for precision instruments).
Insert fuel (Coal) and the two recipe metals into the Bellows Alloy Kiln. Operate the side bellows to increase the draft and collect the smelted alloy ingots.
guidebook.quantumindustries.mechanical_t: Rotational Torque Transmission and Mechanized Wood Cutting
Mechanical Shafts connect torque sources (such as the Hand Crank or Water Wheel) to workshop machines, including the Mechanical Sawmill and Grain Mill.
The Mechanical Sawmill uses shaft-driven rotating blades to cut logs with a higher yield than manual processing.
Connect Mechanical Shafts to the Mechanical Sawmill or Manual Mill input, drive them with a Crank or Water Wheel, and insert logs/grain at the top of the machine.
guidebook.quantumindustries.hydraulic_po: Continuous Mechanical Torque from Flowing Water
The Primitive Water Wheel converts the potential and kinetic energy of falling water into continuous mechanical rotation, replacing manual cranking.
When correctly placed against flowing water, it drives shaft lines to keep sawmills, crushers and dynamos running continuously.
Place the Water Wheel with water flowing down its side paddles and connect Mechanical Shafts to the central hub to distribute torque.
guidebook.quantumindustries.mineral_bene: Raw Ore Comminution and Doubled Metal Yield (2x Dust)
The Jaw Crusher compresses raw ores between two hard, toothed plates, reducing each raw ore to two purified Mineral Dusts.
This hybrid machine can be driven by mechanical pulses in Era I or supplied continuously with electricity (FE) in Era II, doubling your ingot output.
Insert raw ore into the Jaw Crusher and drive it mechanically or electrically (FE) to produce 2x Mineral Dust, which can be smelted directly into ingots.
Copper Wire and Insulated Copper Wire can be installed on floors, walls and ceilings, automatically connecting in six directions between generators, batteries and machines.
Bare Copper Wire acts as a basic busbar (with thermal losses and a shock risk when energized), while Insulated Copper Wire protects the operator and reduces line losses.
Right-click a block while holding Copper Wire or Insulated Copper Wire to install an electrical network between your generators and machines.
guidebook.quantumindustries.manual_dynam: Converting Mechanical Rotation into Electricity (Forge Energy)
The Manual Dynamo begins the transition to the Electrical Era. Its magnetic rotor spins inside stationary copper coils, inducing a direct electrical current (FE).
It can be driven manually or coupled to mechanical shafts and water wheels, sending energy directly to copper cables or adjacent accumulators.
Operate the Manual Dynamo by right-clicking (or connect mechanical torque) and attach Copper Cables to its output to power accumulators and electrical machines.
guidebook.quantumindustries.scientific_a: Computational Station and Era II: Electricity
The Tier 2 Scientific Analyzer marks the transition from a primitive mechanical workshop to modern electromagnetic engineering.
Equipped with an oscilloscope, crystal lattice display and digital buses, this bench lets you progress between Eras and conduct Era II (Electrical) research.
Build it using deepslate, lapis lazuli, copper sheets and your notebook to take the next step toward electrical automation.
Install the Tier 2 Scientific Analyzer in your workshop and interact with it to access the cyan panel and research Era II technologies.
guidebook.quantumindustries.galvanic_sto: Electrochemical Energy Storage (FE) and Network Stabilization
The Voltaic Pile and Lead-Acid Accumulator store electricity as chemical potential between copper/zinc or lead plates immersed in an acidic electrolyte.
They buffer the factory's power supply, absorbing excess energy from dynamos and delivering high current to presses and induction furnaces on demand.
Connect the Accumulator input to generators and its output to machines using Copper Cables. Use Inspection Goggles or Test Probes to monitor the charge in FE.
guidebook.quantumindustries.load_protect: Battery Threshold Control and Mechanical Impact Generation
The Load Relay monitors adjacent accumulators and enables or cuts current/Redstone signals according to configured thresholds, preventing deep discharge.
The Piezoelectric Transducer uses quartz crystals to convert steps, impacts or mechanical pressure into immediate electrical pulses.
Place the Load Relay next to the battery bank to automate generators and consumption lines.
guidebook.quantumindustries.thermal_anne: Metal Heat Treatment and Highly Ductile Heated Ingots
The Annealing Forge (Bellows Brazier) heats iron, copper, bronze, brass and steel ingots to their recrystallization range, relieving internal stresses in the crystal lattice.
Heated ingots resist deformation less strongly and are essential for advanced forming and wire drawing.
Place the Brazier over a heat source (fire, lit campfire, magma, or lava) and insert metal ingots; use the Hand Bellows optionally for a faster blast.
guidebook.quantumindustries.wire_drawing: Die Drawing — Four Wires per Sheet and Noble-Metal Wires
The Bench Wire Drawer pulls metal sheets through calibrated dies of progressively smaller size, producing four conducting wires per sheet without trimming waste.
It efficiently draws not only Copper, but also Gold, Electrum and Constantan for instrumentation and heating coils.
Place a metal sheet in the Bench Wire Drawer and operate the pulling mechanism to draw four calibrated wires per operation.
guidebook.quantumindustries.electromecha: Forge Energy (FE) Powered Stamping and Heavy Rolling
The Electromechanical Press replaces manual work at the Forming Bench with a motorized linear actuator powered by electricity (FE).
It automatically rolls steel, invar, bronze and iron sheets as soon as it receives raw materials and enough electrical energy.
Connect an energized Copper Cable to the Electromechanical Press and feed ingots into the upper chamber to produce metal sheets automatically.
guidebook.quantumindustries.electric_all: Induction Smelting — Steel, Invar, Electrum and Constantan
The Electric Alloy Smelter uses FE-powered induction coils to reach temperatures beyond the Bellows Kiln while maintaining precise component ratios.
It unlocks Era II engineering alloys: Steel (Iron + Coal), Invar (Iron + Nickel), Electrum (Gold + Silver) and Constantan (Copper + Nickel).
Connect electrical power (FE) to the Electric Alloy Smelter and insert the two metal/dust components to synthesize high-purity specialty alloys.
guidebook.quantumindustries.fluid_hydros: Hydrostatics, Fluid Transport (50 mB/t) and Chemical Settling
Copper Pipes and Glass Sight Pipes transport liquids through communicating vessels and pressure, while the Peristaltic Pump moves fluids at 50 mB/t against elevation changes.
The Settling Vat uses gravity and liquid reagents to separate mineral sediments and prepare electrolyte solutions.
Connect tanks and the Settling Vat with Fluid Pipes and install the Peristaltic Pump to transfer water, electrolytes and reagents.
guidebook.quantumindustries.pneumatic_tr: Automated Item Logistics with Air Pulses and Filtering
The Bellows Ejector injects compressed-air pulses that move items rapidly through Pneumatic Tubes between furnaces, crushers and chests.
The Gravitational Sorter automatically separates items in transit by mass and type, organizing production lines without manual intervention.
Install the Bellows Ejector at machine outputs, connect Pneumatic Tubes to the destination and use the Gravitational Sorter to route ores, dusts and ingots.
guidebook.quantumindustries.chemical_lea: Mineral Chemistry — Hydrochloric Acid (HCl) and Phosphate Fertilizer
In the Settling Vat, Halite brine reacts to produce Diluted Hydrochloric Acid (HCl), a powerful reagent for pickling and mineral leaching.
Combining processed Apatite and sulfur in an acidic medium produces Phosphate Fertilizer, which rapidly accelerates crop growth over an area.
Process Halite in the Settling Vat to obtain HCl and apply Phosphate Fertilizer directly to crops to stimulate immediate growth.
